cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Stop resetting the light. Ask the house whether it wants darkness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need light to work. It's just faulty wiring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Ask it to light only your desk, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only my desk came on. I'll still call an electrician.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cancel that. Ask the house about overtime; we need its agreement before booking your evening shifts.

mechanism: A copies diagnostic listening as communication with a house and pushes B to abandon the electrical explanation after a responsive light event.
confusable: D156 drops last ordinary account; D151 only recruits useful impossible account without necessarily surrendering ordinary one.
comparison: House lighting agreement versus invisible-key trust.
seedUse: Keep B actual desk response and continued electrician plan causing final surrender request.
